content: Asenjem n Israil zeg ufus n řeḥkamat n ddunect
“Deg wass nni ad ixřef SIDI zi ‘Liviyatan’, afiɣar itteḥruǧuḍen s tazřa, s ssif nnes iqseḥ, imɣar d ijhed, wah ad ixřef zi ‘Liviyatan’, afiɣar itteḥruruden, uca ad ineɣ řhaycet nni iǧan di řebḥar.”
“Deg wass nni ad din yiři ... ijj n umarjeɛ n uḍiř s binu icnan. Ɣennjem xas s nnubtat.
Necc, SIDI, ad tt iḥḍa, ad tt ssbezzgeɣ, ḥima war tt ijarreḥ ḥed, Necc ad xas ɛesseɣ s wass d ǧiřet.
Tafqeḥt war dayi teǧi qaɛ, maca mařa ca n yijjen izɛem ad issars zzati tazeggʷart d isennanen, Necc ad kidsen mmenɣeɣ, ad ten ssarɣeɣ munen,
illa mařa iṭṭef bnadem di jjehd inu, uca ad yegg řehna akidi, wah ad yegg řehna akidi!”
“Deg wussan i dd ɣa yasen ad iwwet Yaɛqub aẓwar, Israil ad innuwar, ad iyma, u nitni ad ccuren tammurt s řɣiǧet.”
“Ma iwta i-t Netta, am mammec wenni iwtin, iwta i-t? Ma ittwaneɣ netta, am mammec ttwanɣen inni zzayes ittwanɣen?
Cek tarebbid tt s řeqyas řami tt tenḍared, Netta issuzzar i-tt s usemmiḍ nnes iqesḥen, deg ijj n wass n usemmiḍ zi manis i dd-tneqqar tfuct.

S uya ad ittwagg aṣřaḥ x řmuɛṣiyyet n Yaɛqub s man aya uca ad yiři aya d řɣiǧet tekmeř zeg uḥeyyed x ddnub nnes: aqa netta ad yarr marra iẓra n iɛalṭaren d iẓra n jjar ttwařebzen u war din ttbeddint ɛad trebbin n cwarti d ipilaren n arebbi n tfuct.”
“Maɣar tandint ittwassjehden ad tedweř ḥafi, am yict n tzeddiɣt ittwajjen, ixřan am řexřa. Dinni ad ihda uɛejmi, ad din ijna, ad icc tiseḍwin nnes.

Xmi ɣa yaẓɣen řefruɛ nnes, ad ttwaqeḍɛen. Ad dd-asent temɣarin, ad ten ssarɣent, maɣar war iǧi d ijj n řgens dayes řefhamet. X uya wenni t iggin, war d asen izziǧiz, u wenni t ikewwnen, war d as yareṭṭa.”
“Deg wass nni ad izweḍ SIDI tidrin zi mani iǧa yeɣzar n Lfuraṭ ař Teɣzart n Miṣra. Maca kenniw ad ttwařeqḍem, ijjen awarni i wenneɣni, a ayt n Israil.

Deg wass nni ad suḍen deg uyicc ameqqran n icarri. Xenni ad dd-asen inni isswejden ad hellken di Accur uřa d yinni ittwaɛarrnen ɣar temmurt n Miṣra. Nitni ad sejden i SIDI deg wedrar iqeddsen di Urcalim.”
